newsitem.title: UNITED ARAB EMIRATES: SOCCER-JAPAN BEAT CHINA 1-0 TO TOP GROUP C.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JAPAN BEAT CHINA 1-0 TO TOP GROUP C.

text.p: Defending champions Japan recorded their third successive victory in the Asia Cup when they scored in injury time to beat China 1-0 on Thursday.
The result ensured South Korea -- one of the favourites before the 12-nation tournament started -- qualified for the quarter-finals from group A, where they were third.
South Korea needed Japan, their co-hosts of the 2002 World Cup, to win the group C game to be sure of qualification.
China were awaiting the outcome of the group's second match of the day between Uzbekistan and Syria to see if they qualified for the last eight.
Japan, who had already booked their quarter-final berth, now face Kuwait in the knockout stage on Sunday after collecting nine points from three games.

A clever back heel by substitute Syoji Jo split the Chinese defence and set up Naoki Soma a minute into injury time. Soma unleashed a fierce left-foot shot that beat Chinese goalkeeper Ou Chulliang from 10 metres.
